title: Head of Strategic Partnerships, Labs
description:
About Scale AI
 Our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. The Enterprise AI business delivers performant, reliable, and production-grade AI applications to enterprises across all industries by providing Generative AI expertise and infrastructure.
 The Role
 Scale is looking for a seasoned leader and operator to own Scale Enterprise's partnerships with frontier AI labs and foundation model providers. This leader will build and turn our lab relationships into a go-to-market and technology advantage for the Enterprise business.
 This is a revenue-minded role. You will build joint go-to-market motions with model providers, structure technology and commercial partnerships, and make sure Scale is the preferred partner for taking lab models into production at enterprise scale. You need to be strategic, technically fluent, and able to execute in a fast-moving, competitive market.
 This role is highly cross-functional. You will work closely with Enterprise sales, product, engineering, research, finance, legal, and marketing. You will also coordinate with Scale's broader relationships with these labs.
 You will
 Define and deliver the strategy for Scale Enterprise's partnerships with frontier AI labs and foundation model providers
 Build trusted relationships with go-to-market, partnerships, applied AI, and executive leaders at partner labs
 Structure and negotiate partnerships covering joint go-to-market, co-selling, referrals, model access and commercial terms, and technical integrations
 Build joint offerings that pair partner models with Scale's applications, evaluation, and data capabilities to speed up enterprise deployments
 Set up co-sell motions and rules of engagement with lab enterprise sales teams, including joint account mapping and deal registration
 Generate significant top-of-funnel pipeline through lab partnerships, with clear accountability against Enterprise revenue targets

title: Recruiting Coordination Specialist I
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
 About the People Team
The People team helps Affirmers cultivate a high-performing, inclusive organization. We focus on three core areas: attracting talent aligned to our mission, enabling growth through people and team development, and retaining employees through thoughtful experiences and rewards. We develop Affirm’s people programs and systems to create a workplace where all employees can thrive and contribute meaningfully. By investing in our people, we create a long-term advantage for the business.
 We are looking for a collaborative and adaptable Recruiting Coordination Specialist I to deliver a thoughtful candidate experience and keep hiring moving efficiently.
 What You’ll Do
 You will own interview scheduling, including complex schedules that require judgment and flexibility.
 You will partner with recruiters, hiring teams, interviewers, and administrative partners to keep interviews on track.
 You will provide candidates with clear, timely communication throughout the interview process.
 You will resolve scheduling challenges independently, escalating broader issues when needed.
 You will own defined projects and process improvements that strengthen recruiting operations and the candidate experience.
 You will support interviewer operations and training to improve the hiring experience.
 What We Look For
 Experience managing interview coordination in a fast-moving recruiting environment.
 Strong judgment when navigating complex scheduling and changing priorities.
 Clear written and verbal communication with candidates and internal partners.
 Experience owning projects or improving recruiting processes.
 Ability to build effective working relationships across teams.
 Experience with Greenhouse, automated scheduling tools, and Google Workspace is preferred.

title: Consulting Partner Romandie (Strategy & Data/AI Transformation)
description:
Who we are

Artefact is a global data and AI consulting firm. We help organisations turn data and AI into measurable business impact across the value chain, from strategy and operating model to data platforms, AI products and marketing. More than 2,500 consultants, data scientists and engineers work for over 1,000 clients worldwide, including Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi.

In Switzerland, our team of around 50 people works from Zurich and Lausanne with Swiss and international companies. Our work covers AI strategy and governance, data transformation and AI use cases that run in production.

What you will be doing: Key responsibilities

We are looking for a Partner to take over and grow Artefact’s commercial business in Lausanne. The office already serves clients across Romandie, and its Tech chapter is led by a Partner on site. You will take over an established client portfolio and grow it against ambitious targets: deepen existing relationships, win new accounts in industry, retail and luxury, and grow the team that delivers them.

Your role will encompass:

  • Taking over existing client relationships in Romandie through a structured handover, and growing them into broader, multi-year partnerships.
  • Opening new accounts with business leaders (CEO, COO, CMO, Chief Digital Officer, heads of business units) at industrial, retail, consumer and luxury companies in Romandie, and at the regional headquarters of international groups around Lake Geneva.
  • Growing Artefact’s Lausanne office with the Swiss Managing Partner and our Lausanne Tech Partner: more clients, more revenue and a larger team. You will also strengthen Artefact’s visibility in the French-speaking business and academic ecosystem.
  • Leading client executives through data and AI transformation, so that Artefact becomes their partner of choice for it.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About Us
 Nopan is a payment performance platform built by former merchants, focused exclusively on account and wallet payment methods. We help large merchants, fintechs, and PSPs turn payments into measurable revenue drivers. We are payments nerds who are excited about global changes happening in the industry and we want and know how to make it better. In just 18 months, we secured our license from the Dutch Central Bank, formed partnerships with Europe's major payment schemes, including becoming a Principal Member of EPI/Wero, and went live with initial customers. Backed by leading investors, we are now scaling to become the default performance layer for account and wallet payments in Europe. If you're excited about solving big problems and creating something from the ground up, this is the place for you.
 What You’ll Do
 Collaborate closely with the founding team to define, design, and implement the core product.
 Contribute to product strategy and roadmap discussions, bringing your technical expertise to the table.
 Take ownership of entire features from conception to deployment, and iterate based on user feedback.
 Set up and maintain the tech infrastructure, including cloud services, databases, and CI/CD pipelines.
 Set up data storage solutions and ensure data integrity and security.
 Optimize system performance and scalability to support a growing user base.

 5+ years of experience in backend development with a strong command of Java and related frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot).
 Proven experience deploying and managing applications on AWS, utilizing services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and others.
 Hands-on experience with Kubernetes for orchestrating containerized applications in production environments.
 Solid understanding of microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and database management (SQL/NoSQL).
 Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automation, and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation).
